name: std::pmr::synchronized_pool_resource::do_deallocate

declarations.code: virtual void do_deallocate(void *p, std::size_t bytes, std::size_t alignment);

intro: Returns the memory at p to the pool. It is unspecified if or under what circumstances this operation will result in a call to deallocate() on the upstream memory resource.
